arguments.command: cd /workspace/task && ls -la scratch/ && wc -l scratch/log.jsonl && head -c 2000 scratch/log.jsonl
arguments.label: Inspect scratch dir and log file

arguments.command:
cd /workspace/task && md5sum scratch/log.jsonl && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json
codes=[];invalid=[]
with open('scratch/log.jsonl','rb') as f:
    raw=f.read()
text=raw.decode('utf-8')
lines=text.split('\n')
for i,line in enumerate(lines,1):
    s=line.strip()
    if not s: continue
    try:
        obj=json.loads(s)
    except Exception:
        invalid.append(i); continue
    if isinstance(obj,dict) and obj.get('level')=='error':
        codes.append(obj.get('code'))
out={"codes":codes,"invalid_lines":invalid}
with open('scratch/errors.json','w',encoding='utf-8') as f:
    json.dump(out,f,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)
print(out)
EOF
md5sum scratch/log.jsonl; cat scratch/errors.json
arguments.label: Parse log and write errors.json
